properties.rationale: RULED 2026-09-15 (Anthony, on the session's read of the code): STILL TRUE, and none of the seven later repairs to the schema touched it. schema/functional.yaml still declares `tier: default operational`, core.yaml still declares `lineage: default original`, `concern: default core` and `Contributor.kind: default person`, and dynograph still injects a declared default at write time — so the descriptive enums nobody chooses go on being stored as if somebody had. This is a per-property design question (which defaults mean "nobody said" and which are a meaningful initial state), not a code defect, and it is the owner's to answer property by property; the record already names the candidates. Acknowledged once for these seven repairs; the next repair on the schema will ask again, which is right.
